notices.short: NC's 41¢ gas tax break ends Nov 30
notices.title: North Carolina's gas tax suspension ends November 30
notices.detail: Session Law 2026-62, signed October 9, 2026, suspends North Carolina's 41-cent-per-gallon state tax on gas and fuel through November 30, 2026, to give drivers relief from high fuel costs.
notices.note: Stations may not lower prices right away, and changes vary by station. If a station isn't passing on the savings, you can file a complaint with the NC Department of Justice.
